title: 18-Fold HUC-02 PUR: With Lagged Streamflow Inputs
subtitle: 531 basins — Models trained on 17 HUC-02 regions (held-out in space during training) and evaluated with lagged observed streamflow Q(t-1), autoregression, or data assimilation in the held-out HUC-02 region during inference.

rows.paradigm: Data-Integration LSTM with 1-Day Lagged Streamflow Q(t-1)
rows.family_description: Clean-room PyTorch re-implementation of the Feng et al. (2020) 256-unit Data-Integration LSTM (DI(1)-LSTM) ingesting daily meteorological forcings, standardized 1-day lagged target-basin observed specific discharge Q(t-1) with binary validity indicator, and 27 static catchment attributes, trained with basin-variance-weighted NSE* loss over 365-day sequences across 6 random seeds on the canonical 531-basin Newman Split-1 Gauged protocol (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 training, 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 evaluation).
rows.notes: 3-seed ensemble (seeds 101, 102, 103) of our faithful clean-room Feng et al. (2020) DI(1)-LSTM implementation (models/feng2020_di_lstm; basinNorm Q/p_mean from training-split basins/dates, Eq. 11 transNorm, CudnnLstm hidden_size=256, dropout=0.5, seq_len=365, batch_size=100, Adadelta, RmseLoss, 300 epochs) evaluated under 18-fold leave-one-HUC-02-region-out (PUR) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 with NLDAS forcing + Q(t-1) (Ensemble Med NSE = 0.742, Mean NSE = 0.299, Med KGE = 0.745).

rows.paradigm: Data-Integration LSTM with 1-Day Lagged Streamflow Q(t-1)
rows.family_description: Clean-room PyTorch re-implementation of the Feng et al. (2020) 256-unit Data-Integration LSTM (DI(1)-LSTM) ingesting daily meteorological forcings, standardized 1-day lagged target-basin observed specific discharge Q(t-1) with binary validity indicator, and 27 static catchment attributes, trained with basin-variance-weighted NSE* loss over 365-day sequences across 6 random seeds on the canonical 531-basin Newman Split-1 Gauged protocol (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 training, 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 evaluation).
rows.notes: Single-model evaluation scored across all 3 individual seed members (seeds 101, 102, 103; evaluation_mode='single_member_mean') of our faithful clean-room Feng et al. (2020) DI(1)-LSTM implementation under 18-fold leave-one-HUC-02-region-out (PUR) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 with NLDAS forcing + Q(t-1) (Single-Seed Med NSE = 0.734 ± 0.002, Mean NSE = 0.227, Med KGE = 0.738).

rows.family_description: Zero-parameter naive lag-1 discharge persistence Q_hat(t) = Q_obs(t-1) serving as an explicit lower predictability benchmark and 1.0-day phase-lag anchor on all three lagged-streamflow leaderboards.
rows.notes: Zero-parameter lower benchmark predicting Q_hat(t) = Q_obs(t-1) (strictly causal carry-forward across 2 missing pre-window days). Quantifies skill extracted by lagged models beyond discharge autocorrelation and provides an exact 1.0 d peak-timing phase-lag reference.

protocol.benchmark_name: CAMELS-531 Unified Model Intercomparison Project (Newman Period)
protocol.train_period: 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 (9 water years, water years 2000–2008; 3,288 daily steps)
protocol.eval_period: 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (10 water years, water years 1990–1999; 3652 daily steps)

spatial_regimes.title: Gauged Simulation
spatial_regimes.description: Temporal split-sample across all 531 CAMELS-US benchmark basins: calibrated/trained on water years 2000–2008 (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30) and evaluated out-of-sample on water years 1990–1999 (1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30).

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Basins (12-Fold Random PUB)
spatial_regimes.description: Out-of-sample spatial cross-validation across k = 12 random folds of the 531 basins (44–45 basins/fold), trained on 11 folds during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out fold during water years 1990–1999.

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Regions (18-Fold HUC-02 PUR)
spatial_regimes.description: Zero-shot regional extrapolation across all 18 USGS two-digit HUC-02 hydrologic regions: trained on 17 regions during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out HUC-02 region during water years 1990–1999.

forcing_regimes.title: Single CAMELS Forcing
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by a single standard CAMELS-US meteorological dataset (Daymet, Maurer, or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: Multiple CAMELS Forcings
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven simultaneously by any combination of two or three standard CAMELS-US meteorological datasets (Daymet, Maurer, and/or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: With Lagged Streamflow Inputs
forcing_regimes.description: Models ingesting lagged observed streamflow, autoregression, or data assimilation alongside meteorological forcings (or donor-gauge transfer in PUB/PUR).

forcing_regimes.title: Freeform Forcings (Non-CAMELS Inputs)
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by non-CAMELS meteorological forcing products (such as AORC, EM-Earth, or ERA5-Land).

provenance_categories.Literature: Skill scores extracted directly from a published paper evaluated on the standard splits.
provenance_categories.Archive: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs associated with a prior published paper.
provenance_categories.Archive*: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs on a partial basin subset (<531 basins) or non-standard time period.
provenance_categories.MIP Re-run: Published model re-implemented and re-run by the MIP on the standardized 531-basin splits.
provenance_categories.Contribution: New model contributed directly to the MIP benchmark.
